span.p:
Clean Separation of Concerns:

• WalManager: Orchestration only
• Serializers: Format conversion only
• MemtableManager: Memory operations only
• DiskManager: I/O operations only
• RecoveryManager: Recovery logic only

Each component has a single,
well-defined responsibility

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
Performance Achievements:

• Write: 14,939 vectors/second
• Latency: 0.07ms per vector
• Memory: 40% reduction
• Recovery: 10x faster

Achieved through:
• OptimizedWalWriter batching
• Clean component boundaries
• Parallel recovery
• Direct-to-storage recovery

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
Serialization Formats:

Proto (Default):
• Native protobuf
• Zero overhead
• Cross-language support

Avro:
• Schema evolution
• Compression built-in
• Legacy compatibility

Bincode:
• Rust-native performance
• Smallest size
• Fastest serialization
